shortDescription: Bloomberg reported that the consumer price report released last Friday showed core inflation accelerated more than expected in August, prompting futures market investors to raise the odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike at its September 15-16 meeting to above 85%.

title: Core Inflation Beats Forecasts, Lifting Fed Rate-Hike Odds Above 85%
